test_demo_notebook: test the habitat-lab demo notebook by running pytest with nbval-lax on the ipynb file
get_config: load a habitat-lab configuration from a yaml file using habitat.get_config
read_write_config: modify a habitat config in-place using the habitat.config.read_write context manager
check_config_paths_exist: check if dataset config paths exist using PointNavDatasetV1.check_config_paths_exist
run_notebook_test: run a jupyter notebook test with pytest.main using the nbval-lax flag
